incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert: 5xx spike on /v1/embeddings - routing error detected for alias=\"text-embed-small\" (pinned version mismatch)
Sami: seeing lots of embedding requests turning into chat/generation runtime errors, 503s and schema mismatches in logs
Devon: confirmed — requests with signal type=embedding are getting routed to variant 'v2.3.1-chat' which rejects the embed input shape -> returns 500s
Mira: who pinned that alias/version? any recent rollout? customers complaining search ingest jobs failing
Alex: I deployed a quick routing change for canary earlier but `rb` reported it applied, didn't realize alias mapping included embeddings alias. my bad, pinging logs now
Lee: logs -> sample: ```
2026-03-15T14:32:10Z INFO route_request alias=text-embed-small user=svc-search
2026-03-15T14:32:10Z DEBUG resolve_variant -> pinned=v2.3.1-chat
2026-03-15T14:32:10Z WARN model_incompatibility input_type=embedding expected=embed-capable actual=chat-variant
2026-03-15T14:32:10Z ERROR inference_fail code=INCOMPATIBLE_VARIANT status=500
```
Anya: customers impacted: 3 orgs running nightly index jobs, several failing. Pager duty triggered P1 for one account (INC-5021).
Sami: oncall SRE taking lead. @Devon can you confirm if a rollback of the alias pin will immediately restore previous routing? any cache/propagation delays?
Devon: rollback will revert alias to previous version (v2.2.9-embed) but routing cache TTL is 30s; some in-flight requests may still hit wrong variant for ~30s. we should also disable canary and add an emergency override: `routing.override alias=text-embed-small version=v2.2.9-embed --force`
Mira: recommend also toggling fallback policy to avoid auto-fallback to chat variants while we fix pinning. Set fallback=none for that alias.
Alex: running rollback now -> `rb rollback-alias text-embed-small --to v2.2.9-embed`
incident-bot: action logged by Alex at 2026-03-15T14:34:02Z
Alex: override applied and canary disabled. watching metrics.
Sami: metrics look good, error rate dropping from 22% -> 2% over last minute. still seeing a small tail of 500s.
Devon: clearing routing caches on edge nodes to flush old mapping: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/flush-routing -d 'alias=text-embed-small'` -> started
Lee: verification: embedding response samples now valid, similarity vectors produced. sending smoke test results to #support-ops.
Anya: customer impact note: affected window ~14:32 to 14:35 UTC, ~3 minutes of failed embed requests, primary impact on nightly index jobs. created ticket INC-5021 and updated customer-facing status page entry.
Mira: did we have an automated test to catch alias->variant incompatibility on rollout? if not, add to postmortem list.
Sami: quick postmortem bullets (live):
- immediate cause: incorrect variant pinned to alias used by embedding path (human error during canary roll)
- propagation: routing cache TTL and in-flight requests caused ~30s tail
- impact: 3 customers affected, several ingest jobs failed, no data loss, business impact low-medium
- mitigation: rollback alias pin, force override, flush caches, disable fallback to chat variants
- followups: add guardrails in deployment flow, verify deployment UI shows alias types (embed/gen/chat), create automated test blocking pin if variant incompatible with alias type
Devon: assigning followups: RB-389 add preflight check for alias type (owner: Devon), RB-390 add UI confirmation dialog for pinning to variant with mismatched capability (owner: Alex), RB-391 alert: pinned-variant-incompatibility (owner: Lee)
Alex: sorry team, lesson learned. will be more careful with canary targets.
Anya: support note drafted and sent to affected customers; they acknowledged.
Sami: handing off to Dev-oncall for deeper root cause and postmortem writeup. @Devon you're on postmortem owner.
Devon: taking it. will collect logs and draft postmortem by EOD.
incident-bot: incident severity set to P1 at 2026-03-15T14:35:10Z, status: mitigated -> monitoring
Mira: extra ask: add a metric/alert for alias-pin-to-variant where variant.capabilities does not include requested API type (embedding/chat/generation).
Sami: agreed. can we also add a temporary guard: block pinning variants with different primary API unless explicit override flag used?
Devon: yes, implementing guard now in routing service. shipping canary change shortly.
Lee: adding to runbook: step to verify alias mapping post-rollout + command snippets we ran.
Anya: final note: postmortem to include timeline, customer impact, and rollout process change. closing thread once postmortem link is up. :white_check_mark:
